name: EGA pond _openAPond unbounded buyback percentage
summary: The EGA deposit pond 0x67db1b06 exposes payable _openAPond(uint256,uint256). It swaps percent/100 of the remaining deposit into EGA via swapExactETHForTokens with amountOutMin 1, without bounding the caller's percent to 100. With a 1,500 WBNB flash loan, the attacker bought EGA and called _openAPond with 1 wei and a percent of 100 times the pond's balance. The pond then spent its entire 506.67 BNB buying EGA at the inflated price, and the attacker sold its EGA back into the pair.

loss.notes: Exact native-BNB depletion of pond 0x67db1b06e507603d19a27fa128c80969e629a38e: eth_getBalance 506665157500000000038 wei at block 42857880, and 1 wei (the attacker's msg.value) at 42857881. The attacker's net profit was 481.023461112559800467 WBNB; the gap went to swap fees and EGA's transfer-tax recipients. The 1,500 WBNB flash loan and the 1 wei input are attacker-supplied and are not loss. The BNB is valued at the DefiLlama WBNB quote.

ageReset.description: Direct, non-upgradeable runtime whose EGA token and router addresses are constructor constants. The unbounded percentage in _openAPond is present from deployment.

limitations: The pond has no verified source. The percentage logic is read from the creation bytecode's 0x9305a1fe path and the exploit trace, not from source text.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and age. Source-1 (block 42857881, index 97): attacker contract 0x55fa881a2676c16fcc8d3678d10290e76f00fd96 takes a 1500 WBNB flashLoanSimple from lending pool 0x6807dc923806fe8fd134338eabca509979a7e0cb (receipt log 177). It swaps the WBNB for EGA 0xd151e5f58b6dad0ec955e7148735c96f4e3b2ffa in pair 0x535b248c820f658a81dc109da7ef695996b7b1d9 (log 180), then calls pond 0x67db1b06 0x9305a1fe(50666515750000000003800, 0) with value 1 wei. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): the pond calls PancakeRouter 0x10ed43c718714eb63d5aa57b78b54704e256024e swapExactETHForTokens (0x7ff36ab5) with value 506665157500000000038 and amountOutMin 1 (logs 187/188), then transfers the bought EGA to 0xdead. The attacker sells EGA for 1981.773461112559800467 WBNB (log 201), repays 1500.75 WBNB (log 206) and keeps 481.023461112559800467 WBNB (log 208). Creation bytecode of the pond (Etherscan getcontractcreation), 0x9305a1fe body: require(msg.value > 0); amount = msg.value; if (arg1 > 0) amount -= arg1*msg.value/100; if (arg0 > 0) { buy = arg0*amount/100; router.swapExactETHForTokens{value: buy}(1, [WBNB, EGA], this, now+30); burn received EGA }. There is no caller check and no bound arg0 <= 100, so buy is paid from the pond's balance. Other entry points: 0x20a9734c is owner-only withdraw; 0x744fb6ca is a signed user withdrawal. Identity/age: eth_getCode empty at 41437454; keccak 0x5df9b229b109d9d84f0807c1c5c5049af28a6ef675213e8d02c37261696ba762 (7635 bytes) at 41437455 and 42857880. Source-2 (block 41437455, index 18) is the top-level creation by 0x3eb9bea34de71c9805bbf267e9ae92ac8685f02e. Storage slots 1 and 4 hold constructor constants EGA and router, and slot 0 holds owner 0x3eb9bea3, unchanged at 42857880. The runtime has no upgrade path. Earliest exercise: Etherscan txlist (4588 txs, blocks 41437455..43773210) and txlistinternal (4588 entries) are complete. Of the pond's 2497 value transfers to the router, every one sent in a direct user call is at most that tx's msg.value. The only transfer in a tx not sent directly to the pond, and the only one above 50 BNB, is source-1.

Reviewed loss. eth_getBalance(pond) = 506665157500000000038 wei at block 42857880 and 1 at 42857881. Source-1 internal value transfer pond -> router of 506665157500000000038 wei, wrapped to WBNB (log 187 Deposit) and paid into the EGA pair (log 188). Valued at DefiLlama WBNB 562.7 (quote time 1728154729) for request time 1728153484.
